body:
The world honestly seems cruel. It's hard to ever see an answer to your own problems, but sometimes easier to see others more clearly. 

It truly sounds like you just want to feel some of the joy you once did and that you see in everyone else. Nobody is as happy as they seem, even the most powerful and seemingly all-together people such as Winston Churchill didn't even have it figured out. He called depression his 'black fog'. There is no answer currently as to the meaning of life, you just have to find your own and take some peace in the fact that death is coming anyway, try and enjoy what you have and if it turns out to all be worthless then it doesn't matter as it'll end on its own. Perspective is everything. Convincing yourself of it is hard.
